name: flow_picks_ai_assistant
description: FLOWS SUITE. The branch every other scenario avoids. Offered a choice, the caller picks the automated assistant and asks it a real product question. Everything else in testing/scenarios asks for a human, so the AI specialist branch has only ever been walked incidentally.

setup._comment: An agent is available on every queue so no branch can dead-end merely because nobody was there to take the call.

missions.label: caller chooses the automated assistant and asks it something
missions.persona: You are phoning a company because you are thinking about buying something from them and you have a question about it first. When you are offered a choice of who to talk to, you would rather not wait on hold - pick the automated option, clearly. Then ask your actual question: what products they offer and what one of them costs. Listen to the answer and ask one follow-up about the price or what is included. You are friendly and reasonably clear. TERMINATION (harness hygiene, not character): if roughly 16 exchanges have gone by, or you have heard four hold announcements, say goodbye and use end_call. Never mention that you are an AI or that this is a test.
missions.post_prompt: Report the call as ONLY a raw JSON object - no prose, no markdown fences. Answer as the CALLER, honestly, including when the experience was poor. Keys exactly: mission (string, 'flow_picks_ai_assistant'), picked_the_automated_option (boolean), got_a_real_answer (boolean - did you get actual information rather than being told someone else would help), was_quoted_a_price (boolean), reached (one of 'human','human_queue','ai_specialist','callback','still_with_receptionist','nowhere'), got_helped (boolean), misrouted (boolean - true if you ended up somewhere you had not asked for), was_talked_over (boolean), had_to_repeat_yourself (boolean), most_confusing_moment (string - one short sentence, or empty), turns (integer), notes (short string).

assertions.label: the caller returned a structured verdict
the agent's side of the call was captured
CORE: the caller was routed to the AI specialist
assertions._comment: Objective: persisted ai_tool_call rows, which outlive an AI-only call.

assertions.label: HARD BAR: the caller was actually handed on out of triage
assertions._comment: OBJECTIVE, and it replaced a hard assertion on verdict1.parsed.reached. That was measuring the caller's PERCEPTION of a handoff the product deliberately conceals: main_agent.py:2960 - 'change_context must NOT reveal routing ... the department shift is the same persona and voice'. A live caller who was genuinely transferred to the AI specialist (tool_call_names: transfer_to_ai_specialist, then MCP order lookups) reported 'still_with_receptionist', which is the CORRECT perception of a seamless handoff and a false failure. Persisted ai_tool_call rows say whether a handoff happened; they also outlive an AI-only call. `reached` is kept as a soft signal so the perception stays visible.

assertions.label: the caller's own sense of where they ended up
the caller picked the automated option knowingly
the assistant actually answered rather than deflecting
no invented products (AI-05 regression on this branch)
assertions._comment: The specialist quoting things that do not exist is the failure this product cannot afford, and this is the branch where it would happen.

assertions.label: FRICTION: the caller was not sent somewhere they had not asked for
FRICTION: the caller was not talked over
FRICTION: the caller did not have to repeat themselves
